title: botbotrobotics/BotBrain
abstract:
Modular open-source brain for legged robots. Web UI for teleops, autonomous navigation, mapping & monitoring. 3D-printable hardware that runs on ROS2.

One Brain, any Bot. # BotBrain Open Source (BBOSS) BotBrain is a modular collection of open source software and hardware components that lets you drive, see, map, navigate (manually or autonomously), monitor, and manage legged (quadrupeds, bipeds and humanoids) or wheeled ROS2 robots from a simple but powerful web UI. The hardware gives you 3D printable mounts and an outer case so you can put BotBrain on your robot without guesswork. - Designed around Intel RealSense D435i and the NVIDIA Jetson line - Officially supported boards: Jetson Nano, Jetson Orin Nano (support for AGX and Thor coming soon) - Everything is modular - you don't need to run every module (some heavy AI modules require Orin AGX) 📹 Watch BotBrain intro video 📹 📹 Watch BotBrain complete 1 hour of autonomous patrols in our office ✨ Features at a Glance Dashboard & Fleet Control Complete dashboard to see status, robot info and quickly jump to other sections CockPit Predefined control page with full front/back camera, 3D model, map and navigation as well as quick controls My UI Customizable control interface with all the features of cockpit Missions Create missions for the robot to execute and navigate autonomously Health View BotBrain's complete health: CPU/GPU/RAM usage, state machine nodes control and status, wifi connection control User Profile Customize the look and feel of BotBrain, set custom colors, and speed profiles Open Source Hardware Quick to 3D print, easy to build, and designed to snap onto any robot. Get your robot running with BotBrain in less than 30 minutes. 📹 Watch BotBrain hardware assembly guide ## Compleate features list ### Multi-Robot Platform Support - **Unitree Go2 & Go2-W** - Quadruped robots with full hardware interface and control - **Unitree G1** - Humanoid with upper-body pose control and FSM transitions - **DirectDrive Tita** - Biped with full control - **Custom robots** - Extensible framework for adding any ROS2-compatible platform - **Legged & wheeled** - Architecture
abstract_zh: BotBrain 是一套模块化的开源软硬件组件，让你通过简洁而强大的 Web UI 控制、观察、建图、导航（手动或自主）、监控和管理四足、双足、人形或轮式 ROS2 机器人。硬件部分提供 3D 打印支架和外壳，可快速安装到任何机器人上。系统围绕 Intel RealSense D435i 和 NVIDIA Jetson 系列设计，官方支持 Jetson Nano 和 Jetson Orin Nano（AGX 和 Thor 支持即将推出）。所有模块均可选配，部分重型 AI 模块需要 Orin AGX。功能包括仪表盘与集群控制、驾驶舱、自定义 UI、任务创建、健康监控、用户配置等。支持 Unitree Go2/Go2-W、Unitree G1、DirectDrive Tita 等平台，并可通过扩展框架适配任意 ROS2 机器人。
tldr_zh: 开源模块化机器人大脑，Web UI 控制，支持多种腿式/轮式平台。
cover_zh: 开源机器人大脑｜一个 Web UI 控制所有腿式机器人

>[!abstract] 一句话总结：BotBrain 提供一套模块化开源机器人大脑，包含 Web UI 遥操作、自主导航、建图与监控功能，并搭配 3D 可打印外壳与 Jetson/RealSense 标准硬件适配，支持多种 ROS2 腿足与轮式机器人。


# 一、动机

> 腿足机器人软件与硬件方案通常闭源、碎片化，缺乏统一的可扩展开源框架，导致开发者在部署、导航与遥操作上重复造轮子。


# 二、方法

> BotBrain 提供一套模块化开源机器人大脑，包含 Web UI 遥操作、自主导航、建图与监控功能，并搭配 3D 可打印外壳与 Jetson/RealSense 标准硬件适配，支持多种 ROS2 腿足与轮式机器人。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 官方支持 Unitree Go2/Go2-W、Unitree G1、DirectDrive Tita，并支持自定义 ROS2 平台；硬件组装可在 30 分钟内完成；支持 Jetson Nano/Orin Nano，后续扩展 AGX/Thor；可在办公室环境完成 1 小时自主巡逻。


# 四、对我的启发

> 该开源系统对机器人具身智能与跨形态部署有直接参考价值，但依赖特定硬件（Intel RealSense D435i 与 Jetson），且部分重 AI 模块需更高算力平台，可能限制消费级低成本部署。
